title: Japan restricts foreign contact (sakoku)
summary: Shogun Tokugawa Iemitsu issued edicts that sharply limited foreign trade and travel; few foreigners could enter.
why: Foreign contact ran through a few channels, like the Dutch at Dejima, until after 1853.

notes.problem: Title/why overstate isolation: source says Japan 'was not completely isolated'; some scholars challenge the closed-country view and prefer 'kaikin'.
